data: Microsoft's operating income rose from $88.5 billion in fiscal 2023 (year ended June 30, 2023) to $128.5 billion in fiscal 2025 (year ended June 30, 2025), an increase of about $40.0 billion, or roughly 45%. Fiscal 2023 revenue was $211.9 billion, giving an operating margin of about 42%, while fiscal 2025 revenue was $281.7 billion, for a margin of about 46%. Operating income therefore grew considerably faster than revenue, which rose about 33% over the same period. These figures come from my recollection of Microsoft's annual reports rather than a live lookup, so please check them against the 10-K filings before relying on them.
